title: Distribution under a map
statement: Given finite sets $\alpha$ and $\beta$, a function $f:\alpha\to\beta$, and a probability distribution $p$ on $\alpha$, define the distribution of $f(a)$ when $a$ is sampled according to $p$ by assigning to each $b\in\beta$ the probability $\sum_{a\in\alpha:f(a)=b}p(a)$.
